rows.49:6984:
That is the story behind this tree.
{a}{f:|}, you of all people should understand, shouldn't you?
The grudge that surrounds this tree, and the lingering attachment to this world.
You understand, don't you?
Go on, come closer and take a good look at the trunk.{p}
rows.49:6ad4:
I heard laughter right beside me.
It was Iwashita.
Iwashita was looking down at {f:me|me} triumphantly.
You moved, didn't you.
That means you've broken your vow.
You see, I had been chosen as this tree's sacrifice.
Perhaps because it bathed in so much human blood, this cherry tree came to crave sacrifices.{p}
rows.49:6c04:
When this tree appeared in my dream and said it would make me its sacrifice, I wondered what would become of me.
So I cast a charm.
One that would pass the cherry tree's curse on to anyone who made a promise with me and then broke it.
It could have been anyone, but I thought this was the perfect opportunity.
There. Now I'm free.
Thank you, {a}{f:|}.
I don't know when it will be, but when you become this tree's sacrifice, I'll at least light some incense for you.
After all, you saved my life.
Heh heh...
Now, shall we go back to the newspaper club room?{p}
rows.49:6df0:
"That couldn't be helped! So there's no reason for us to take responsibility!"
Hirooka blurted it out in a forceful tone.
That overbearing voice must have made his blood boil before he knew it.
He hardly seemed like the meek Hirooka of a moment ago...
He was always calm and never spoke so forcefully, so she seemed a little startled.
Then, unexpectedly, the voice said,
"...I see. The young are quick to get heated.
I will give you time.
I will not say how long. Reflect on what you did.
And when you are ready to take responsibility, come here again.
You must come. I warn you, running is useless.
I am always watching you."
That's what it said.{p}
rows.49:7080:
"Anyway, we have to get out of here!"
He took her hand and ran.{p}
rows.49:70d4:
Before they knew it, the two of them had run quite a long way from the school.
"We should be all right now."
Then they walked on, neither of them saying a word...
It was he who broke the silence first, unable to bear it any longer.
"Orihara. Let's forget what happened under that cherry tree tonight. From tomorrow on, we must never talk about it, not even when we're alone together. It was a dream. We have to forget it, and quickly."
She nodded.
Then he walked her home.
At her front door, she let go of his hand reluctantly and closed the door.
After a sleepless night, morning began again as if nothing had happened.
The harder they tried not to think about that night, the more it gnawed at them.
Even when they were together, things were awkward between them, and it was no fun at all...
And so the days went by.{p}
rows.49:73c0:
Then, after school exactly one week after that night, he worked up the nerve to talk to her.
"I'm sorry to bring this up again myself after what I said, but..."
"It's all right. It's been bothering me too, so much that I can't sleep at night. I was almost about to bring it up myself."
It seems both of them had been dying to talk about that night.
"I'm thinking of going back to that cherry tree once more. I have something in mind, too...
And the cherry tree did say we must come... What will you do, Orihara?"
"...I'll go too. I don't think there's anything to worry about as long as you're with me, Hirooka... I really don't think that voice was a dream. I wonder if maybe it was the voice of that cherry tree..."
And so they decided to meet at the back gate at ten o'clock that night.{p}
rows.49:7698:
For some reason, this time both of them reached the school gate before the agreed time.
Then they walked around behind the old school building.
A waning moon lit the surroundings with its feeble light.
Fukuzawa mentioned it earlier, didn't she?
The cherry tree was just a little past full bloom, at its most beautiful moment, as the petals fell.{p}
rows.49:77b0:
There was no wind, but the fluttering petals had piled up all around, as if dusted with powdered sugar...
The moonlight was feeble, but the area around that cherry tree alone was bright, as if it were reflecting the light.
And a fragrant, almost sweet scent hung in the air.
"Looking at it like this, it's just a beautiful cherry tree..."
He murmured it to himself.
"Orihara, would you mind staying here?"
With that, he walked over to the cherry tree.
Then he seemed to be walking around the tree, bent low...
After circling the tree several times, he walked back this way.
"Sorry to keep you waiting."
In his hand he was holding something like a bottle.
And a strange smell was drifting toward her...
"You can't mean...★"{p}
rows.49:7a34:
He gave no answer, and threw a lit oil lighter at the cherry tree.
Yes, when he was circling the tree earlier, he had been pouring gasoline.{p}
rows.49:7afc:
The fire raced like a serpent of flame along the places soaked with gasoline, and in no time it swallowed the cherry tree.
The cherry blossoms seemed to make perfect kindling, and the tree burned with tremendous force.
It was beautiful, like a tree that had burst into blossoms of flame.
The flowers of fire were in full bloom, you might say.
The flames lit up the surroundings with an eerie brightness.
"Now, once the cherry tree has burned down, nothing more should happen..."
He was rejoicing all by himself.
Behind him, she thought she saw the shadows of a man and a woman deep within the blazing cherry tree's flames.
He didn't seem to notice, though.
Those two were definitely there, unshaken even amid the flames, staring fixedly this way.
On instinct, she cried out.{p}
rows.49:7d60:
"What have you done?! There was no need to go and burn it!"
She was stunned that he, normally so gentle, had gone this far.
"Ahahahaha! Once this cherry tree burns! As long as this cherry tree burns☆ Ahahahaha☆"
Maybe he had gone a little mad ever since that incident...
Just then, the fire, creeping along the fallen petals, closed in around the two of them.{p}
rows.49:7f1c:
The flames burned more fiercely than they had expected, and the two of them couldn't move...
Beyond the shimmering heat haze, she felt as if those two from before smiled for an instant.
The fire caught their clothes and charred their skin with a sizzle, giving off a foul smell...
The two of them writhed in agony until they breathed their last.
And then, from somewhere, that voice could be heard.
"You have taken responsibility properly, haven't you? That is what taking responsibility must mean..."{p}
rows.49:80a8:
Their bodies have never been found.
Of course, there's no way they ever could be, is there?
Because even the fact that those two ever existed in this world had vanished...
The school apparently said someone must have set the cherry tree on fire as a prank, though.{p}
rows.49:8190:
And you know, the cherry tree everyone thought had burned put out buds the following spring and bloomed again.
Thanks to those two sacrifices, I wonder?
Strange, isn't it?
And that's how it came to be what it is now.
Its trunk is a strange color, unlike an ordinary cherry tree's, isn't it?
That's the reason why.{p}
rows.49:82a8:
How do I know this story, you ask?
The truth is, I had a dream about that cherry tree.{p}
rows.49:82f4:
Those two, burned black, were standing at the foot of the cherry tree in full bloom.
And the two of them said this to me:
"You have been chosen as this cherry tree's sacrifice. You should rejoice.
But if you absolutely refuse, we will teach you just one way to escape.
First, bring someone, anyone, beneath the cherry tree.
Then make two promises.
One, not to move from that spot.
The other, never to scream.
Once you have exchanged those two promises, tell that person the story we are about to tell you.
If that person breaks either promise, they will take your place right then and there.
Understood...?"
Those two told me something else, too.
They said that cherry tree changed after the hanging incident...
It came to live off fear, sorrow, and the bitter regrets people left behind in this world.
That's why it wants sacrifices...
And I have to find a substitute within one week of having that dream.{p}
rows.49:863c:
It's already been five days since then...
Heh heh.
It's a pity, but you kept your promise properly, didn't you?
So I'll have to find another substitute...{p}
rows.49:8730:
"I don't want to talk to the likes of you!"
Hirooka shouted.
But that was far too reckless.
The voice seemed angry.
"Insolent wretch. Then I shall see to it that you never speak again!"
At that same moment, an invisible force seized Hirooka.
And it tore his mouth apart.{p}
rows.49:8838:
"Aaaaaaaah!☆"
At the sight of it, Orihara fainted.{p}
rows.49:8890:
...The next day, the two of them were found.
Everyone who saw Hirooka's body, its face torn into upper and lower halves, was baffled.
It wasn't something a human being could have done.
But Orihara, the witness, couldn't say a thing.
She had lost her mind.
Maybe she's still in a hospital somewhere, even now.{p}
rows.49:89ac:
We mustn't listen to it.
Orihara sensed that by instinct.{p}
rows.49:8a00:
Hirooka, on the other hand, was listening to what the cherry tree was saying as if he were hypnotized.
Orihara was able to watch the scene calmly.
When she looked into his eyes, he seemed to be pretty far gone.
Uneasy at this scene, which by any measure looked anything but good, Orihara grabbed his shoulder.
"Hirooka, please come to your senses!
There's no telling what will happen if you do what the cherry tree says, here and now!
Please! Come back, come back to yourself!"
His eyes, which seemed to be staring into the distance, showed no sign of coming back.
Even so, she kept shaking his shoulders and hitting him.
All she could think about was getting out of there with him, even one second sooner.
Just then, he turned toward her, as if something had suddenly occurred to him.
"Let's get away from here, quick!"
She took his hand and started to run.
At that moment, he squeezed her hand as hard as he could.
And he didn't run at all; he just stayed right where he was.{p}
rows.49:8d7c:
As she turned around, he pulled her forcefully into his arms.
Her heart skipped a beat in spite of herself.
In her fear she had forgotten all about embarrassment, but now she could feel her own heart pounding.
If only it weren't a situation like this, how happy she would have been.
But he just held her close and wouldn't move.
She looked up at his face.
He was still staring into the distance.
"Pull yourself together! Hirooka!"
She called out to him.
Then his eyes, which had been gazing far away until now, glared down and locked onto her.
He was like a completely different person from the Hirooka who was always so kind and gentle.
"We're going to take responsibility... Come on..."{p}
rows.49:8fec:
And then he forced a kiss on her.
"Mmmph..."{p}
rows.49:90cc:
You can't just do what some unidentified voice tells you, can you?
Hirooka grabbed Orihara's hand and started to run.
But the voice followed them.
"Running is useless. If you will not do as I say, I will make you pay the price."
The voice came from right beside him.
Hirooka turned to the side.
And the voice was coming out of Orihara's mouth!
Orihara grinned and cupped Hirooka's face in both hands.
Then she forced a kiss on him.{p}
rows.49:9264:
He tried to shake her off, but he couldn't.
It didn't seem like a girl's strength.
Then a pain shot through the back of his throat.
And then an unbelievable pain.
Something hot and hard was being forced down his throat.{p}
rows.49:9334:
The next instant, a tree branch burst out of the nape of Hirooka's neck.
Hirooka slumped to the ground, limp.
Orihara drew her tongue out of Hirooka's mouth.
Her tongue had become long and hard, just like a cherry branch.{p}
rows.49:9404:
Then she slowly walked to the foot of the cherry tree and tied the ribbon from her hair to a thick branch.
And then she hanged herself with that ribbon.{p}
rows.49:9544:
Are you scared?
No, you don't!
Don't go back until my story is finished!
You mustn't go back!
It's only going to get scarier from here.
If my story got cut off halfway like this, I'd regret it for the rest of my life.{p}
rows.49:9600:
And I'd hate you for the rest of my life, too...
What's that? 'There's no need to go that far'?
How nice for you. So you plan to go through life carefree like that forever.
Hmph. You won't be able to stay so easygoing for long.{p}
rows.49:96d8: I'll keep on talking, just for you...{p}
rows.49:9704:
Hey, what do you think you're doing, ignoring me?
You're the one who said you wanted to hear the stories, aren't you?
We were asked to come, and we're doing you the favor of telling them.
Don't you think you're being rude?
I'm not exactly free myself, you know.
So you're going to keep up that attitude to the end...?{p}
rows.49:987c:
It's simple.
Because I am the servant of this cherry tree... no, of those two...
Those two appear in my dreams almost every night.
I started having those dreams when I was a first-year.
And those two tell me stories.
I've sat on a branch of the cherry tree and listened to all kinds of stories.
Almost every single night, those two's stories unfold in my dreams in vivid images.
Every night, their agony-filled faces appear right before my eyes, filling my sight...
No matter how tightly I shut my eyes, those faces of terror float up through my eyelids, always staring at me.{p}
rows.49:9a64:
Because it's just a dream...?
No. Even when I'm just going about my normal life, if I close my eyes like this...
Of course, I was frightened at first.
I was afraid of night coming...
But now I'm fine with it.
Even things like that are no big deal once you get used to them.
Heh heh.
And at the end of every dream, the two of them always say,
"You are the one we have chosen. For these three years, you shall be our servant. And each year, you shall offer one student of this school to this cherry tree as a sacrifice. If you do not, you yourself will become the sacrifice in their place. Understood...?"{p}
rows.49:9c50:
That's right. If I offer up one sacrifice every year for these three years, I'll be released from the hold of those two and the cherry tree.
Otherwise...{p}
rows.49:9d5c:
Heh heh.
...You still don't get it, do you?
All I need is someone to take over after me.
Before I graduate, that is.{p}
rows.49:9de0:
Ah, I can feel something!
The cherry tree... those two are speaking to me!
What is it you want to say?
What are you trying to tell me?
...Oh, is that so? Really?
I understand...
It seems those two have chosen you to take over after me.
I can tell...
Those two seem pleased about it, too.
About the birth of a new servant...
If you don't believe it, that's fine. You'll just be the one who pays for it.
And you'll see that dream every night, too.
And those two's faces of terror, as well.
Don't worry, you'll get used to it soon.
Oh, and there was a promise you made me earlier, remember?
Thank you for keeping it.
Keeping that promise was one of the conditions for being chosen, you see.{p}
rows.49:a064:
...I'm so happy.
Heh heh, it's no use telling anyone.
It's obvious they'll just think you're crazy and won't take you seriously.
You'd do well to remember that.
Lastly, that attitude of yours earlier made me terribly angry, but I'll forgive you.
After all, this is how I got my freedom.
I'm so happy, my anger has just flown off somewhere!
Heh heh!
I really should say thank you to you...{p}
rows.49:a218:
Ah! I feel something again!
M-my head... it h...u...r...t...s...
Ugh, my head's splitting!
...Yes, it'll go away soon, so please don't worry.
I'm sure that by the time this terrible headache is gone, all those cursed memories will have vanished completely.
I'm sure of it...
I'm fine, I can walk on my own...
I still have to listen to everyone's stories, after all.
Now, let's go back to the club room...{p}
rows.49:a3d8:
You really are a coward...
You made me two promises at the start, didn't you?
That no matter what happened, you wouldn't move from here until my story was over.
And that you'd never scream.
Have you forgotten already?
You tried to cut my story short...
What were you planning to do?
Where were you trying to go?
Well, never mind. In any case, breaking your promise means you've agreed to become this cherry tree's... sacrifice.
You say that's a lie?
No, it's no lie at all.{p}
rows.49:a580: One day, I had a dream.{p}
rows.49:a5ac:
Cherry blossoms were blooming in the darkness, and all I could hear was a voice.
"You have been chosen as this cherry tree's sacrifice.
You should rejoice.
But if you absolutely refuse, I will teach you just one way to escape.
First, make two promises with someone.
One, not to move from that spot.
The other, never to scream.
Once you have exchanged those two promises, tell that person the story I am about to tell you, beneath that cherry tree.
If that person breaks the promises, or says partway through that they don't want to hear any more, they will take your place right then and there.
Understood...?"
That's what it said...
And also, of course, that if you kept your promises, I wouldn't be saved...{p}
rows.49:a810:
Heh heh, it's no use trying to run.
Your body won't obey you anymore.
Look... the cherry tree's roots have already got a firm grip on your feet, and they won't let go, will they?
Stop your useless struggling.
What bad luck you had.
To be frank, anyone would have done as my substitute.
I'll take pity on you, you poor thing.
And I'll say thank you.
It's all right, don't worry.
Once you're dead, no one will know you ever existed.
Because your very existence will vanish...{p}
rows.49:a9f0:
...You're getting sleepier and sleepier, aren't you?
And you can feel yourself slipping away, can't you?
This is goodbye, then.
I won't forget you.{p}
rows.49:aa84:
Oh, pardon me. That's not really possible, is it...
Heh heh.{p}
